package_info.why_malicious: No evidence of actual malicious packages or code snippets is present in the provided report. The content and images focus on vulnerability scanning and reporting of known CVEs in open source dependencies, not on the discovery or analysis of malware or intentionally malicious code.

behavioral_signatures: Automated scanning of dependencies for known vulnerabilities
Reporting of CVEs and severity levels in open source packages
file_indicators: Presence of vulnerable package versions (e.g., PyYAML 5.1.2, jinja2 2.10, werkzeug 0.10, etc.)
network_indicators: No suspicious network indicators; only legitimate CLI/API calls to JFrog/Xray services
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for the use of outdated or vulnerable open source dependencies by scanning dependency manifests (requirements.txt, package.json, etc.) and container images for known CVEs. Use SCA tools to automate detection and reporting of vulnerabilities, but note that this does not indicate malware—only insecure or outdated software components.
